audit_scopes.attempt_id_overlap: HARD-REJECT if the same attempt_id appears in >1 split
audit_scopes.object_set_overlap: WARN >5% / REJECT >10% of test object_sets seen in train (SKIP if absent)
audit_scopes.scene_camera_overlap: HARD-REJECT if a (scene_id, camera_pose_hash) pair spans train+test (SKIP if absent)
audit_scopes.time_bleed: REJECT if train/test time ranges overlap beyond the median attempt duration (SKIP if synthetic/index timestamps)

interpretation.what_passed_means: passed=true means no HARD-REJECT finding. Under strict=False, WARN + NOTE findings are free passes; a NOTE marks an audit that was SKIPPED because a required field was absent. This proves split separation on the AUDITED dimensions only.
what_this_does_not_prove: leakage on UNMEASURED fields (operator, time-of-day, lighting, ...)
